rsm.report_entry.where: Fighter Settings: the guide bar's entry after the key's icon, for R / pad X.

rsm.report_title.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the option window's title.

rsm.report_row_send.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug (option window): a row's title. Cut with ... at run time past about 40 Latin characters. The action that sends the report.

rsm.report_sending.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug (option window): a row's title. Cut with ... at run time past about 40 Latin characters. Replaces Send while it goes.

rsm.report_failed.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug (option window): a row's title. Cut with ... at run time past about 40 Latin characters. %s = one of the report_err_ texts.

rsm.report_err_network.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: goes into 'Not sent: %s'. Starts in lower case in languages that have one.

rsm.report_err_steam.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: goes into 'Not sent: %s'.

rsm.report_err_banned.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: goes into 'Not sent: %s'.

rsm.report_err_full.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: goes into 'Not sent: %s'.

rsm.report_err_refused.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: goes into 'Not sent: %s'.

rsm.report_err_account.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: goes into 'Not sent: %s'. The account's own room on the server is full (100 MB).

rsm.report_status.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: a row of the window docked on the left. Cut with ... at run time past about 40 Latin characters. The first row, a choice.

rsm.report_st_ok.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: an option of the STATUS row, shown in capitals as Wael wrote them.

rsm.report_st_bug.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: an option of the STATUS row, shown in capitals as Wael wrote them.

rsm.report_st_waiting.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: an option of the STATUS row, shown in capitals as Wael wrote them.

rsm.report_st_to_test.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: an option of the STATUS row, shown in capitals as Wael wrote them.

rsm.report_st_fixed_soon.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: an option of the STATUS row, shown in capitals; %s is the release that holds the fix (like 1.27.1). A report whose fix is in a release not published yet. Keep it short: the row is width-limited.

rsm.report_st_fixed_update.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: an option of the STATUS row, shown in capitals; %s is the release that holds the fix (like 1.27.1). A report whose fix is in a release published, and the player's files are older: he must update the mod, then test. Keep it short: the row is width-limited.

rsm.report_st_info.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: an option of the STATUS row, shown in capitals. The admin asks the player for more information (his question is on the guide's line); the player answers by sending his report again. Keep it short: the row is width-limited.

rsm.report_row_reply.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the Send row while the status is NEED INFO: sending the text again is the answer to the admin's question.

rsm.report_msg_question.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides. %s is the admin's question to the player (plain text from the server, up to 160 characters). Shown while the status is NEED INFO.

rsm.report_msg_note.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides. %s is a message from the admin attached to the report (plain text from the server, up to 160 characters), shown after the status message (fix in a release, TO TEST).

rsm.report_st_checking.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: an option of the STATUS row, shown in capitals as Wael wrote them. While the server answers.

rsm.report_row_describe.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: a row of the window docked on the left. Cut with ... at run time past about 40 Latin characters.

rsm.report_row_change.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: a row of the window docked on the left. Cut with ... at run time past about 40 Latin characters. Once a description exists.

rsm.report_row_update.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: a row: Send, once a report exists.

rsm.report_sum_outfit.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: a line of the list under the rows. %s = the outfit's name, a comma, its colour.

rsm.report_err_status.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: goes into 'Not sent: %s'. The report's status changed meanwhile.

rsm.report_sum_character.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: a line of the plain list under the rows, one line of about 80 Latin characters, no sentence around the value. %s = a fighter's name. Shares its line with the colour.

rsm.report_sum_description.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the label over what the player wrote; it stays still, his text moves under it.

rsm.report_msg_unreachable.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides.

rsm.report_msg_to_test.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides.

rsm.report_msg_fixed_soon.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides. %s is the release that holds the fix. Shown when that release is not published yet.

rsm.report_msg_fixed_update.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides. %s is the release that holds the fix. Shown when it is published and the player's files are older.

rsm.report_msg_sent.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides.

rsm.report_msg_replace.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides. The overwrite warning; with report_msg_also on the Update row.

rsm.report_msg_need_text.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides. While Send can do nothing.

rsm.report_msg_same_text.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides. While Update can do nothing.

rsm.report_msg_also.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the message on the guide's line, right-justified at the window's right edge; past its room it slides. While the focus is on Send or Update: what goes with the report.

rsm.report_row_mark_fixed.where: Fighter Settings > Report a bug: the row shown when STATUS is OK at TO TEST: pressing it tells the author it is fixed. Capitals, as Wael wrote it.
